events.title: James I of Aragon enters the city of Valencia
events.description: After defeating the Moors of the taifa of Balansiya, King James I of Aragon entered the city of Valencia, an event regarded as the dawn of the Kingdom of Valencia, a component realm of the Crown of Aragon.
events.html: After defeating the Moors of the taifa of Balansiya, King James I of Aragon entered the city of Valencia, an event regarded as the dawn of the Kingdom of Valencia, a component realm of the Crown of Aragon.

events.title: King Sejong promulgates the Korean alphabet
events.description: Sejong the Great of Joseon published the Hunminjeongeum, introducing a new phonetic script now called Hangul. Designed so ordinary people could read and write, it is commemorated each year on Hangul Day.
events.html: Sejong the Great of Joseon published the Hunminjeongeum, introducing a new phonetic script now called Hangul. Designed so ordinary people could read and write, it is commemorated each year on Hangul Day.

events.title: The Catholic cantons declare war on Protestant Zürich
events.description: Pressed by a food embargo, the five Catholic cantons of Central Switzerland declared war on the Protestant canton of Zürich, starting the Second War of Kappel. On 11 October they defeated Zürich at Kappel, where the reformer Huldrych Zwingli was killed.

events.title: Connecticut charters the school that became Yale
events.description: The Connecticut General Assembly chartered the Collegiate School to train ministers and public leaders. It later settled in New Haven and in 1718 was renamed Yale College after the benefactor Elihu Yale.

events.title: Peter I of Russia defeats a Swedish convoy at Lesnaya
events.description: In the Great Northern War, Peter I of Russia caught a Swedish convoy under General Adam Ludwig Lewenhaupt at Lesnaya, in present-day Belarus, and defeated it. The convoy was carrying reinforcements and supplies to the main Swedish army in Ukraine.

events.title: The Treaty of Bern founds the Universal Postal Union
events.description: Representatives of 22 countries signed the Treaty of Bern, creating a single postal territory for exchanging letters. Its anniversary is marked as World Post Day.
events.html: Representatives of 22 countries signed the Treaty of Bern, creating a single postal territory for exchanging letters. Its anniversary is marked as World Post Day.

events.title: John Lennon is born in Liverpool
events.description: John Winston Lennon was born at Liverpool Maternity Hospital. As co-founder and songwriter of the Beatles, and later as a solo artist and peace campaigner, he became one of the defining figures of 20th-century popular culture.

events.title: Uganda gains independence from Britain
events.description: Uganda became independent with Milton Obote as prime minister and the Kabaka of Buganda later as president. Its early decades were marked by political upheaval, including the dictatorship of Idi Amin.
